en.t: For six years my work lived in five places.
en.d: Now it lives in one. GitHub had the code. My CV had the roles. LinkedIn had the stories. Client decks had the results. The Elyon film lived on a hard drive. en.t: Every process assessment I have run ends with the same finding, and it is never in the…
en.d: 98% of organizations report AI tools in use that nobody approved. Only 37% have a policy about it. The instinct is to ban the tools. That is the one thing I would not do first. My engagement at Elyon Industrial LATAM started with a business and data process assessment: auditing the workflows and the Databricks pipelines behind product and inventory data…

en.t: A 15% reduction in operational delays did not come from a model.
en.d: It came from counting where things stopped. I want to describe that work honestly, because it is the least glamorous thing on my CV and the one I would repeat first at almost any company. No prediction. No agent. I took the operational process data and measured how long each step actually took, versus how long everyone believed it took. Those two numbers…
